question: 仓库 pallets/itsdangerous，截止时间 2026-11-16T06:31:18Z，冻结默认分支 672971d66a2ef9f85151e53283113f33d642dabd。Issue #347 提出的类型问题是什么？最终对应哪个 PR、哪个提交，实际改动覆盖哪些模块？请给出处。

claims.text: Issue #347 讨论的类型问题是：`Serializer.default_serializer` 已知返回 `str`，所以 `Serializer().dumps()` 实际返回 `str`；但类型检查器不会自动承认这一点，用户仍需显式写成 `s: Serializer[str] = Serializer()`。
讨论中出现的重载设想是：当未提供 `serializer` 参数时，使 `self` 的类型为 `Serializer[str]`；davidism 同时指出多数用例不传 `serializer`，因此某些重载几乎不会有用。
davidism 表示已打开 PR #374 供评审。
davidism 后续表示，采用 override hint 后，mypy 和 pyright 已能在未提供 `serializer` 参数时识别默认类型为 `Serializer[str]`。
上下文可核对的冻结版本文件包括 `docs/conf.py`（Sphinx 项目配置）与 `src/itsdangerous/signer.py`（签名实现）。

evidence.quote: Any suggestion on how to handle the fact that `Serializer.default_serializer` is known to return `str`? If someone did `Serializer().dumps()`, we know it returns `str` since they didn't override `default_serializer` to something that returns `bytes`, but the user still has to do `s: Serializer[str] = Serializer()` to get the type checker to acknowledge that.
evidence.author: davidism

evidence.quote: Most use cases do not involve providing a `serializer` argument, so that overload would almost never be helpful. I guess you mean an overload where if `serializer` is not given then `self` is `Serializer[str]`?
evidence.author: davidism

evidence.quote: I just opened a PR if you want to review it: https://github.com/pallets/itsdangerous/pull/374
evidence.author: davidism

evidence.quote: Thanks, the override hint was what I needed, I did what I suggested and now mypy and pyright know the default is `Serializer[str]` if no `serializer` argument is given.
evidence.author: davidism
